name: Patina
desc: A metal plate corroding in real time: oxidation nucleates, creeps outward against the grain of the alloy, ripens through tarnish into crust, spalls off in flakes to bare fresh metal, and runs mineral stain down the face — while a raking light finds only the parts still bright.

corrosion.doc: how much of the oxidation front reads as crust

scale.doc: grain of the alloy — mottle + bloom size

energy.doc: specular amplitude on the bare metal

hue.doc: rotates the whole oxide ramp (0 = the true colour of the metal)

style.doc: verdigris: copper going blue-green · rust: iron blooming orange over dark scale · silver_tarnish: thin-film interference through gold, magenta, blue to black · lichen: stone crusting sage and ochre · mineral: false-colour assay bands with contour lines — clinical, non-representational

act.doc: creep: steady advance · bloom: fast growth churning against constant spalling · strip: a front sweeps the plate back to bare metal every minute and a half

seed.doc: deterministic seed — same number, same piece
